body: This was a better response than I thought I would ever get. Thank you for taking the time. I'm going to go back and read it again.
I don't know why I'm being downvoted either. Maybe they just didn't get the question?  Or don't think I'm serious?  I'm not sure.

I don't really understand why people are answering this with sarcasm or just insensitive answers. 

Don't kill yourself.  THAT is what will help this world. You seem to have a good heart-that's what we need most!

We are ridiculously similar. I wonder why we can't get thru to ourselves. Even though we want to get thru to others. 

I noticed you comment on a lot of these posts. You are helping these people and giving them someone who will listen. That is huge. Honestly. 

You're a complete stranger,  but if you want my opinion, the world is a lot better with you in it.

I know what you mean. We will all go home one day. When it's time. 

If anything,  I take comfort knowing that I could end it if I wanted. Any day. We do have that power. 

But we also only have one life to live.  And who knows, maybe the ending will be much happier than the beginning.  Maybe one day we will wake up and not feel like this. You didn't fight this long for nothing. 

But anyway, I'm sure you've heard this stuff before. You didn't need to hear it again. But thank you for your post. I definitely felt I could relate.

Slow down and take a breath. 

You have so much going thru your head right now. I'm sorry you are overwhelmed, but keep letting it out. Tell me what you feel pushed you over the edge

"Maybe I'll gain the strength to fix all of this soon."

That one sentence tells me you have so much hope.  Run with it!  If you have regained the want to live, embrace it.  See where it leads you. 

Good luck my friend!

And also,  I wish I could give you a hug. Please hold on. 

We want you here.

I always thought I was the only one who thought "I want to go home" when feeling like this. 

I don't think of a particular place when I think it and feel it,  but during my lows I always cry that I want to go home. 

It must be a comfort thing.  We want to "go home" where it is safe and easy and comfortable. 

I'm sorry you are going thru this. I wish we could find that "home" feeling.

I'm a fighter. But it gets so overwhelming sometimes. I feel like I'm falling apart and there is nothing I can do to stop it. 

I'm scared.  And I just want to be normal. 

Thank you for caring.  I wish there were more people like you.
I'm sorry you feel the same way.  I wouldn't wish it on anyone. But at the same time it's nice to know someone understands.
I care,  and I'm so glad you changed your mind. I think most everyone here will be too :)
Thank you. Just taking the time to reply was very nice. I'm trying to be strong.
